A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VeriTime research work, with 24 readable pages and complete Appendices A–F. Pages 2–24 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; differences are confined to first-page publication information and spacing.

before.justification: v1 reports original VeriTime evaluations on TSRBench, TimeSeriesExam, and DROP in Tables 1–3, alongside ablations, sensitivity analyses, and case studies in Section 3 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark results, ablations, sensitivity analyses, and case studies in Section 3 and Appendix B.

M1.justification: The TSRgen synthesis pipeline, six-step reasoning procedure, difficulty-based data scheduling, supervised fine-tuning, GRPO training, and reward components are unchanged in Section 2 and Appendix D.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same seven TSRBench tasks, TimeSeriesExam, DROP, and Time-MMD case studies. No training or evaluation domain, task, or scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including general LLMs, Time-MQA, Time-R1, ChatTS fine-tuning, classical time-series models, and the data-selection alternatives in Tables 1–3 and 8.

E3.justification: The versions retain identical dataset splits, sample counts, evaluation metrics, model sizes, training configurations, and testing procedures in Section 3 and Appendices B–D.

E4.justification: Reward ablations, step-level analyses, scheduling comparisons, temperature and prompt sensitivity tests, generation-count experiments, real-world case studies, and training-dynamics analyses are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix B.

E5.justification: Table 5 retains the same averages and standard deviations across four temperature settings. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, significance-testing, or other uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 1 retains overall VeriTime accuracies of 82.86% for Qwen2.5-3B and 86.55% for Qwen3-4B.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, data-partition formulas, reward equations, and GRPO formulation in Equations 1–19 and Appendix D are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about process-verifiable reasoning data, tailored reinforcement fine-tuning, scheduling, and compact-model performance.

C2.justification: Section 3 retains the same interpretations of reward contributions and difficulty-dependent scheduling. Appendix E preserves the same limitations concerning dataset coverage and the resource-constrained focus on compact models.

D1.justification: Dataset curation details, hardware specifications, Table 13 hyperparameters, and Appendix F prompt templates are unchanged. Both versions provide the same code-access link.

R1.justification: The references and Appendix A related-work discussion are identical. The updated publication notice introduces no change to novelty claims or positioning relative to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 replaces 'Preprint. February 10, 2026' with an ICML 2026 proceedings and copyright notice, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Research prose, headings, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: First-page spacing around the abstract and affiliation/publication footnotes changes to accommodate the longer notice, and the margin stamp is updated. All figures, tables, and page layouts on pages 2–24 render identically.

improvement.justification: The revision updates publication information and makes small first-page spacing adjustments. Scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility details, and all appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in paper quality.
